saw_lines: Shoppers buy storage jars in sets during a kitchen cleanup, and they check arrival before they order.
So the sale is lost in the first line, when no delivery answer tells the buyer the box will arrive.
Your site answers how shipping works, yet 0 of 23 ads mention delivery, so open ads for new buyers with arrival time and door delivery.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site answers how shipping works, yet 0 of 23 ads mention delivery, so new buyers have no reason to order. Open ads for new buyers with arrival time and door delivery, then test that opener against your current copy.
No proof number in your ads
0 of 15 copy ads carry a proof number, so a first time buyer has no count to trust before clicking. Pick one real figure, like a review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it.
4 of 15 copy ads open on one olive oil jar story. Test two new angles against it: price, since no ad mentions cost, and the kitchen clutter the 12 jar set clears, then run the winner in every ad.
Shop now ads land on homepage
7 Shop now ads send buyers to your homepage, not the product, so a buyer clicks an ad and lands on a general store. Point each one to the product its creative shows, such as the 12 jar set.

ads_1: Price and cleanup angles for the jar sets, arrival time in line one
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
